blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, ZAMBOANGA DEL SUR, Philippines — A total of 22 public utility vehicle (PUV) drivers across the Zamboanga Peninsula region tested positive for illegal drug use during a surprise drug testing operation conducted at various transport terminals in time for the observance of Undas on Thursday, Oct. 29. The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency Regional Office IX (PDEA-RO9), in coordination with the Land Transportation Office (LTO), Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB), Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), Philippine National Police (PNP), local anti-drug abuse councils, bus terminal managements, and bus company Rural Transit Mindanao, Inc., executed the simultaneous inter-agency […]...
